jobs.description: The Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) team is seeking a dedicated, skilled, and innovative Applied Scientist with a robust background in machine learning, statistics, quality assurance, auditing methodologies, and automated evaluation systems to ensure the highest standards of data quality, to build industry-leading technology with Large Language Models (LLMs) and multimodal systems. About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Hardware is becoming critical to how AI gets built, and the legal questions are as new as the technology. We're hiring a Commercial Counsel, Hardware to help Anthropic's product teams move fast, build safely, and get the legal calls right.
In this role, you'll negotiate a high volume of fast-moving deals for hardware, components, software, and emerging technology procurement needs. This role will also lead multifaceted technology, data, and partnership deals, many of them the first of their kind at Anthropic.
You'll be the legal and risk partner that technical and business leaders turn to when they need a fast, practical read on a deal or purchase. You'll clear low risk transactions quickly, spot the ones that deserve a closer look, and build scalable solutions as new complexities come up, all while working alongside Procurement and Finance and Legal colleagues in areas like privacy, IP, and trade. Along the way, you'll also support partnerships with major tech companies, universities, and media organizations, which gives you a view across much of the business.
Key responsibilities
Negotiate and close a high volume of agreements for hardware and components, including review of embedded firmware and companion software licenses
Structure and negotiate complex technology, data, and partnership agreements
Track legal and regulatory changes that affect hardware products and components, such as product safety rules and restrictions on foreign-made components, and explain what they mean for our plans
Identify trade, export control, sanctions, and supply chain concerns in cross-border sourcing, and work with our national security and compliance teams to resolve them
Build and maintain self-serve guidance, templates, and AI-assisted review tools so routine purchases don't wait on Legal
Manage outside counsel for specialist questions and overflow volume
Cover other technology or hardware transactions on the Legal team as needed
Minimum qualifications
JD and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar (California preferred)
Hands-on experience buying hardware and firmware, components, and software in high volume, fast-paced environments
Deep experience leading complex deals, such as technology or data licensing, joint development, or supply partnerships
Working knowledge of international supply chains and how sourcing choices (and their associated risks) show up in contracts (lead times, single-source risk, warranties, country of origin, higher risk jurisdictions)
Working knowledge of trade and regulatory compliance for hardware, including export controls, sanctions, tariffs and customs
Clear, plain communication with scientists, engineers, and operators, so legal risk turns into a decision they can act on
A low-ego, "doer" attitude and real interest in taking on work outside your core practice area
Intense curiosity about AI and emerging hardware, and a commitment to responsible AI development
Preferred qualifications
At least 8 years of legal experience in hardware or a closely related technical space, with the judgment to run risk assessments and deals on your own from day one
In-house time at a hardware-intensive technology company (such as electronics, industrial automation, or complex devices) while it was scaling quickly
Experience supporting product or engineering teams as a dedicated counsel
Experience with facilities or on-site vendor services, including the insurance and safety questions
An engineering, product, or other technical background
Experience using AI tools to speed up your own legal work

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. Your safety matters to us.

Key job responsibilities • Own technical direction for Containers — architecture, standards, and what gets built and, just as often, what gets stopped. • Go deep in the work — design reviews, code, operational readiness — on orchestration, scheduling, isolation, and registry systems. • Own the integrated Containers strategy — how the products fit together as one offering — and the technical direction of the container products across ECS, EKS, Fargate, Batch, and ECR. • Drive the integration work that makes the container products stronger together than apart, and make that the fastest path for the teams building it. • Move AI-driven capabilities in Containers from prototype into production owned and operated by the organization. • Build, prototype, and ship — settle disputed direction by making the thing. • Raise the bar across the Containers engineering teams through design reviews, mentorship, and technical judgment. • Engage directly with customers running their most critical container workloads, and turn what you learn into architecture. • Contribute to and shape the open-source projects Containers depends on — containerd, Kubernetes — and represent the organization in those communities. A day in the life A morning goes to a scheduling and bin-packing review, where a placement change would lift host utilization but risks a regression in task-rebalancing behavior customers rely on; the call sits with this role to make and defend. Midday it prototypes the change and lands the direction in code. It closes in the container open-source community, steering an RFC on a project the portfolio depends on toward the architecture Containers is moving to.

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
조직 소개
본 직무는 Coupang Ads 조직의 프론트엔드(프런트엔드) 개발자로서 쿠팡 광고 플랫폼의 새로운 기능을 개발 및 설계하는 역할을 수행하게 됩니다. 쿠팡은 세계 최고 수준의 광고 비즈니스를 구축하기 위한 투자를 하고 있으며, 쿠팡 웹사이트 및 모바일 앱 상에 위치한 주요 구좌에 연관성 있는 광고를 운영하고 있습니다. Coupang Ads 조직은 쿠팡의 판매자 및 공급자에게 셀프서비스 광고 운영 기능을 제공함으로써 쿠팡의 광고 솔루션을 보다 성장시키기 위한 차세대 프로덕트 및 서비스를 개발 중에 있습니다.
Coupang Ads 조직은 쿠팡의 광고 상품을 구현할 수 있는 시스템과 인프라를 개발할 열정적인 소프트웨어 개발자를 찾고 있습니다. 본 직무에는 그린필드 프로젝트 개발과 낮은 레이턴시 및 고가용성(availability) 서비스, 확장가능한 시스템, 프로그래매틱 연동을 위한 API 개발이 포함됩니다. 또한, 풀기 어려운 문제를 파악 및 해결하여 시스템의 확장성(scalability)과 신뢰성(reliability)을 향상시키는 작업과 효율적인 리소스 운영도 요구됩니다.
낮은 레이턴시와 높은 확장성을 갖춘 분산 서비스 개발에 관심이 있으신 분, 세계 최고 수준의 쿠팡 광고 비즈니스 구축이라는 큰 기회의 일원이 되고 싶으신 분, 쿠팡미디어그룹은 이러한 서비스를 함께 개발할 리더를 찾고 있습니다.

jobs.description: Our program management team leads the charge and partners with teams across Amazon to plan, coordinate, and implement mission critical projects resulting from operating a global business in a time of unprecedented change. Successful candidates will have deep experience in at least two of the following three disciplines – Finance, Program Management and Technology – and can become well versed in all three in order to bridge across our diverse group of stakeholders. The candidate needs to be able to easily understand the business line, technical and finance/accounting/tax disciplines, and the impacts of each on the project. They also need to be able to support communications in these areas with current process owners and project stakeholders. jobs.description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) brings new services and features to customers at an unprecedented cadence — more than 3,000 launches a year, and accelerating as the AI landscape evolves. Behind that velocity is the Launch Operations team, which owns the process that governs the lifecycle of bringing every AWS capability to customers, from intake through customer availability. We turn AWS’s innovation velocity into a durable Marketing advantage: driving operational scale so service teams and stakeholders can focus on innovation, and improving signal-to-noise so the most important news reaches customers and enables field sales and partner teams to engage around the launches that matter most. We are looking for a Program Manager II to run the programs that make this possible. You will operate at the center of the launch process, coordinating across product managers, marketing, engineering, security, legal, and field teams to keep launches moving on time and at a high quality bar. This is a role for someone who is organized, resourceful, and energized by the challenge of managing high-visibility, cross-functional programs where the details matter and the scale is significant. You will not just track the process — you will improve it, identifying where the sequential handoffs and manual coordination slow launches down, and designing the workflows and tooling that compress that timeline and align launch velocity with engineering velocity. Key job responsibilities 1. Own the end-to-end launch operations program — defining milestones, tracking deliverables, mitigating risks, and keeping launches on schedule across multiple concurrent workstreams and stakeholder teams. 2. Coordinate across product managers, marketing, engineering, security, legal, pricing, and field teams to align on priorities, remove blockers, and drive launches from intake to customer availability. 3. Identify process gaps in how launches move through the pipeline and implement improvements that raise quality, reduce cycle time, and compress the sequential handoff chains that dominate the launch timeline. 4. Partner with task-owner teams to bring automation directly into their review workflows, improving operational scale so the program can support 3,000+ launches per year. 5. Define and monitor program metrics to measure delivery performance and improve signal-to-noise, then use those insights to inform planning and elevate the most important launches to customers. 6. Apply generative AI tools to streamline processes, status reporting, and program analysis, and help embed these tools into the team’s day-to-day operating model. A day in the life You start your morning reviewing the launch pipeline and flagging any launches at risk of slipping, then work with the relevant task owners to unblock them. Mid-morning, you run a working session with product and marketing partners to align on upcoming Tier 1 launches and lock down next steps. After lunch, you pull together a status update for leadership, summarizing progress, program metrics, and the open decisions that need their input. Between meetings, you are refining the intake process for new launches and looking for ways to remove friction and automate the manual coordination that slows the next cycle down by prototyping that improvement with generative AI tooling before you socialize it with the team. About the team The AWS Lifecycle Marketing team shapes how the world’s leading cloud and AI portfolio reaches customers.
